textos.texto: Ana has a family in Peru. Her father is Jorge and her mother is Rosa. They are her parents. She has one brother and two sisters. Her brother is nine years old and my brother's name is Luis. Her sisters are twins! They are seventeen. Ana also has a grandmother and a grandfather in Peru: her grandparents. Her grandmother is eighty years old. Ana has an uncle, an aunt and four cousins too. Her uncle is married and he has two children: a son and a daughter. Ana is single. In Canada she lives with a friend, and they have a cat. The cat is Tom.

preguntas.enunciado: Las hermanas de Ana son gemelas.
¿Cómo se llama el hermano de Ana?
El gato de Ana es viejo.

textos.texto: This is my family. Who is this? This is my dad and this is my mom. They are my parents. And these? My grandfather and my grandmother: my grandparents. My grandfather is eighty and my grandmother is seventy. This is my uncle. He is divorced. He has a son and a daughter, and they are my cousin and my cousin. My nephew is a baby and my niece is three years old. Is your brother married? Yes, his wife is Canadian. And my sister's husband is Peruvian. And your pet? I have a dog and a cat. My dog is Max. My family is in Peru, but my friend is here in Canada. Her name is Laura.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Quiénes son los abuelos en la foto?
¿De dónde es la esposa del hermano?
¿Cómo se llama la amiga que está en Canadá?

textos.texto: Ana has four cousins in Peru. Two are twins and they are sixteen years old. Her cousin is a girl: her name is Marie. Marie is single. Her brother is married and his wife is Peruvian. They have a baby, so Ana has a nephew. Her aunt and her uncle live with the grandparents. Her grandfather is eighty-four and her grandmother is seventy-nine. Ana has a niece too: she is three. Her family has many people! In Canada Ana lives with a friend and they have a dog and a cat. My family is in Peru, says Ana, but my pets are here.

preguntas.enunciado: La abuela tiene ochenta y cuatro años.

textos.texto: This is my dad and this is my mom: my parents. My father is fifty-two and my mother is fifty. I have one brother and one sister. My brother is married: his wife is Canadian and they have a son. That son is my nephew. My sister is divorced and she has a daughter, my niece. My grandparents live in Peru. My grandfather is old. My uncle and my aunt have two children: my cousins. One cousin is a boy and one cousin is a girl. And the pets? We have a dog. My friend has a cat and a baby cat!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Qué es el hijo del hermano para la persona que habla?

textos.texto: This is the family of Marie. Her father and her mother are her parents. Marie has one brother and one sister. Her brother is married and his wife is Canadian. They have a son, so Marie has a nephew. Her sister is divorced and she has a daughter: Marie's niece. Her grandparents live in England. Her grandfather is eighty and her grandmother is seventy-five. Marie has two cousins: one is a baby. Her uncle and her aunt live with the grandparents. Marie is single. She has a pet: a dog. Her friend has a cat.
